item.title: Russia’s seaborne fuel exports fall slightly in November, data shows
item.description: Russia’s seaborne oil product exports in November were down by 0.8% from October at 7.494 million metric tons as the impact of drone attacks on energy infrastructure was offset to a degree by completion of maintenance at several refineries, data from industry sources and Reuters calculations showed.
